ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Inspection and Testing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inspection and Testing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Inspection and Testing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inspection and Testing.

2. When learning Wiring Systems and Regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.

3. When learning Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

5. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

7. When learning Single Phase AC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Generators.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Generators.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Generators.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Generators.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

9. When learning Power Supplies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Supplies.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Power Supplies.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Supplies.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.

10. When learning Measuring Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Measuring Instruments.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring Instruments.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring Instruments.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring Instruments.

11. When learning DC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for DC Generators.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.
   C. Skip safety briefings for DC Generators.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after DC Generators.

12. When learning Single Phase AC Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Circuits.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Circuits.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Digital Electronics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Single Phase AC Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Diagrams and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.

2. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.

3. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Stage Bipolar Junction Transistor Amplifier.

4. A — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

5. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.

6. C — CPU

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Generators.

8. C — Information and Communication Technology

9. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.

10. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring Instruments.

11. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.

12. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Circuits.
